g.text: Source: Alphabet Q2 2026 earnings; OpenAI announcement; Microsoft FY2025 Q4 earnings

text.style: font-size: 8.6px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #6b7280
font-style: italic; font-size: 8.4px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #6b7280

g.text: Note: Scopes differ and the bars must not be summed. Microsoft's figure covers Azure AI Foundry, a gateway: models served through it are

text.style: font-style: italic; font-size: 8.4px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #6b7280

g.text: counted at the model owner (§7.9, rule 1), so it overlaps with OpenAI's. Rate-based figures are spot rates annualised, which assumes

text.style: font-style: italic; font-size: 8.4px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #6b7280

g.text: the rate held for a full year. Microsoft's figure is FY2025, ended 30 June 2025.
